description: Capabilities for the settings + logs windows. Frontend never spawns arbitrary shells; the only sidecar is the bundled mur-agent-runtime, spawned from Rust via tauri-plugin-shell's typed `sidecar()` API which does NOT need shell:allow-execute. Webview-side spawn permissions are intentionally omitted.
_: Both windows share the same capability set; the React frontend chooses which view to render based on getCurrent().label.
